title: Bag of Bricks - Stone Grey 36
descriptionHtml:
Stone Grey — colour 36

A light, cool neutral for concrete, cloud and clean modern backgrounds. Stone Grey is the go-to when you want a backdrop that feels contemporary rather than warm.

Works well with: Grey 39, Dark Grey 31, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Stone Grey bricks (colour 36) for Memobrick mosaics. A light neutral grey for concrete, clouds and clean modern backgrounds.
